rule.name: js/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization
rule.full_description: Security checks on the substrings of an unparsed URL are often vulnerable to bypassing.

message.text: 'generativelanguage.googleapis.com' can be anywhere in the URL, and arbitrary hosts may come before or after it.
message.markdown: '[generativelanguage.googleapis.com](js/src/auth/google-plugin.ts#L739C39-L739C74)' can be anywhere in the URL, and arbitrary hosts may come before or after it.
